title: Facet load share at lumbar (variable) - Pollintine P, Dolan P, Tobias JH, Adams MA 2004 (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet load share
quantity.definition: % of compressive force transmitted via the neural arc, mean +/- SD (stress profilometry)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Pollintine P, Dolan P, Tobias JH, Adams MA 2004); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Pollintine P, Dolan P, Tobias JH, Adams MA 2004, as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Stress profilometry; neural arc load share.
how_to_simulate: Apply 2 kN compression with 2 deg extension or 6-12 deg flexion
Compute % of compression through the neural arc
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Pollintine P, Dolan P, Tobias JH, Adams MA 2004.

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output. verified 2026-11-12 independent check: values OK vs review Table 2 p.5 (8±6 %, 2±3 %); FIXED source.n 2004 -> null (2004 was the primary's year, not a sample size; review does not state n; primary not in donwload/).

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
